en.title: Mushroom & Cream Soup
en.intro: A stock cube strengthens the flavour. Serve with lemon juice for a distinct taste.

steps.n1: Cut the rabbit into small cubes.
steps.n2: Open and drain the tin of mushrooms.
steps.n3: Heat the ghee in a pot.
steps.n4: Add the rabbit pieces and sear until they change colour.
steps.n5: Add the chopped onion and sear with the rabbit.
steps.n6: Add the chopped garlic and stir in.
steps.n8: Add the mushrooms and stir in.
steps.n9: Add the flour and stir well.
steps.n10: Add the salt and black pepper.
steps.n11: Add the boiling water and let it boil.
steps.n12: Add the milk and stir well.
steps.n13: Leave on low heat until it boils and thickens.
steps.n14: Serve hot with toasted bread and chopped parsley.
